decision_basis: result-put side: recv_wait is 4.41-5.04% of public wall across all four legs (pre- and post-reuse-fix); the coordinator is not starved waiting for results

a single-receiver + reserved-credit rearchitecture attacks a <=5% ceiling while carrying deadlock/credit/durability risk that designs/05 itself flags; not material under the quoted criterion
